name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: 204-wide rail with a head, nav, and foot. 1px on all four sides.
docs: Raster leaves are StyleX. Compile them with @stylexjs/babel-plugin (Vite: @stylexjs/unplugin, Next: @stylexjs/nextjs-plugin). If you would rather not run a compiler, import @noorddev/raster-react instead: it ships precompiled with one stylesheet.

raster.snippet:
Raster

Go to

OverviewDocsComponents
0.3
raster.example:
import { Sidebar, SidebarFoot, SidebarHead, SidebarItem, SidebarLabel, SidebarNav } from "@noorddev/raster-react";

<Sidebar>
  <SidebarHead>Raster</SidebarHead>
  <SidebarNav aria-label="Sidebar">
    <SidebarLabel>Go to</SidebarLabel>
    <SidebarItem href="/" current>Overview</SidebarItem>
    <SidebarItem href="/docs">Docs</SidebarItem>
    <SidebarItem href="/components">Components</SidebarItem>
  </SidebarNav>
  <SidebarFoot>0.3</SidebarFoot>
</Sidebar>

use: A 204px rail for app or docs navigation with a head, groups of links, and a foot.
SidebarLabel to name each group of items.
avoid: Collapsing it on desktop; the rail is the layout.

a11y: Sidebar is an <aside>; SidebarNav is a <nav> named by aria-label ("Sidebar" by default).
SidebarItem is an <a>; current sets aria-current="page".
